# Banking Agent — Enterprise LangGraph Platform

> An enterprise-grade, conversational banking platform built with LangGraph, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, and ChatGroq.

## Core Documentation & Agent Guides
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Complete architecture guide, God nodes, and blast-radius rules for AI coding assistants.
- [GRAPH_REPORT.md](graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md): Graphify codebase knowledge graph report with node connectivity and community breakdown.
- [graph.json](graphify-out/graph.json): Machine-readable AST knowledge graph.
- [README.md](README.md): Human developer quickstart, setup, and overview.

## Key Source Entrypoints
- [agents/supervisor/graph.py](agents/supervisor/graph.py): Master StateGraph supervisor and context-switching router.
- [agents/state.py](agents/state.py): Shared BankingSessionState typed dictionary.
- [apps/api/routes/chat.py](apps/api/routes/chat.py): Chat endpoint managing thread persistence and LangGraph execution.
- [gateway/llm/router.py](gateway/llm/router.py): Production Pydantic structured intent & entity extraction engine.
- [database/repositories/banking_repo.py](database/repositories/banking_repo.py): Async SQLAlchemy banking repository.
- [gateway/tool_gateway/gateway.py](gateway/tool_gateway/gateway.py): RBAC and idempotency security tool gateway.

## Specialized Agent Subgraphs
- [agents/account/graph.py](agents/account/graph.py): Conversational KYC and account opening state machine.
- [agents/transfer/graph.py](agents/transfer/graph.py): Parallel fraud/AML/ledger transfer workflow with HITL confirmation.
- [agents/card/graph.py](agents/card/graph.py): Card freeze/unfreeze, limit changes, and lost card reporting.
- [agents/loan/graph.py](agents/loan/graph.py): Mathematical EMI calculation and DTI eligibility checking.
- [agents/payment/graph.py](agents/payment/graph.py): Biller lookup, UPI verification, and bill payments.
- [agents/support/graph.py](agents/support/graph.py): Decline reason diagnostic and policy RAG search.
- [agents/insights/graph.py](agents/insights/graph.py): Spending analytics, categorization, and budgeting alerts.
